note: Default-FAIL contract. Every criterion starts false and may only be set true via `python scripts/acceptance.py mark` with a real evidence file. taskctl re-runs the commands regardless of what this file claims.

criteria.criterion: THUMBNAIL_ONLY is assigned when no better file exists

commands: uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/unit/test_matching_mismatch.py tests/unit/test_matching_ranking.py tests/unit/test_matching_gates.py tests/unit/test_matching_directions.py tests/unit/test_matching_explanation.py tests/unit/test_matching_policy.py tests/unit/test_matching_abo.py tests/contracts/test_matching_invariants.py tests/property/test_matching_properties.py

criteria.criterion: positive physical crossmatch hard-stops direct pathway
amount changes do not change ordering
rank explanation exactly reconstructs sort keys
ranking donors for a recipient and ranking recipients for a donor both run and agree on the mismatch vector for the same ordered pair
a donor with two HLA-B mismatches and zero DRB1 mismatch outranks a donor with zero HLA-B and one DRB1 mismatch
a partially typed locus yields a range and never a bare zero
deleting any locus typing from a candidate never improves its rank, including DRB3/4/5
